name: einvoicing-compliance-corner
description: The E-Invoicing Compliance Corner — test harnesses and the pinned deploy toolchain. The site itself is two Cloudflare Workers deployed with wrangler from members-worker/ and site-worker/. Run `npm install` once at the repo root: npx walks up the tree, so both Workers and apply_migrations.py then use the pinned wrangler below rather than downloading whatever is newest.

scripts.test:migrations: cd members-worker/migrations && python3 apply_migrations.py --replay-only && python3 test_assertions.py
